clauses.reason: Recording a decision must not cost a validation round.

updates.rationale: Change records feed no check beyond source admission, which runs everywhere, so earlier tree evidence stays exact.
updates.statement: A records-only range changes only paths inside change directories and keeps the contract digest of every change record it changes. Member readiness evidence of a commit stands for each descendant tip reached by a records-only first-parent range: ready there runs source admission and no check, and admission, status and final accept that evidence. A batch increment that is records-only runs source admission and no batch gate check. In test inheritance a change-record path affects no inheritable shard. Final always executes its complete declared gate. This governs wherever an earlier clause names a journal-only suffix or requires a gate run for a records-only increment.

clauses.reason: Observations are answered where the evidence is, and deferral is recorded, not ceremonially transferred.

updates.rationale: Deferred work stays visible at delivery without forcing a follow-up change through readiness and transfer first.
updates.statement: A member or batch workspace may write the journal of an approved change in its tree; a batch write does not claim the change, and final attributes a batch commit that changes only change records to those changes. Resolution evidence is a path in the judged tree or a known validation receipt. A deferral needs only its reason; an optional follow-up names an approved change on any local branch and is judged only when written. The final review lists every deferred item under unfinished_work.

decisions.reason: Recording a decision changed no product input yet cost a full member ready and a re-admission gate, and deferral demanded another change's requirement committed and transferred in the member tree, so agents spent validation rounds to write sentences. Readiness evidence is about the tree its checks read; paths inside change directories that keep every contract digest feed no check except source admission, which still runs everywhere, so earlier evidence stays exact. Alternatives considered: inheriting every shard through impact rules would still run static checks and the batch gate; a separate record-only lifecycle path would add an operation; keeping the transfer rule would keep the follow-up change ceremony. Final stays complete and judges records again. Reopen if a check is found to read change records beyond source admission and traceability, or if unfinished deferrals accumulate unreviewed across deliveries.

transaction.reason: Apply the approved records-only readiness and journal resolution decision.
